Definition: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
BiblicalUsage: 1) to dwell, remain, sit, abide; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sit, sit down; 1a2) to be set; 1a3) to remain, stay; 1a4) to dwell, have one's abode; 1b) (Niphal) to be inhabited; 1c) (Piel) to set, place; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to cause to sit; 1d2) to cause to abide, set; 1d3) to cause to dwell; 1d4) to cause (cities) to be inhabited; 1d5) to marry (give an dwelling to); 1e) (Hophal); 1e1) to be inhabited; 1e2) to make to dwell
